sculpt_barrel_fish.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_barrel_fish.notes: Sculpted fish tub (tapered open tub, three plaited bamboo hoops, a carrying ear with rope, salt crust, five fish tails of different heights). Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures: batched + rolling prop. Families wood / straw / fruit (the fish, as the old model named them).
